# HubSpot

> HubSpot is an AI-powered customer platform providing integrated CRM, marketing, sales, service, content, data, and commerce software for businesses of all sizes.

HubSpot offers a comprehensive suite of business software tools built around a unified Smart CRM platform, enhanced by Breeze AI agents for automation and customer intelligence. Founded in 2006 by Brian Halligan and Dharmesh Shah, the platform serves small businesses through enterprises with integrated solutions for sales, marketing, customer service, and commerce.

## Key Topics

- Smart CRM
- Breeze AI
- AI Agents
- Customer Platform
- Sales Hub
- Marketing Hub
- Service Hub
- Content Hub
- Commerce Hub
- Data Hub
- Lead Generation
- Deal Closing
- Workflow Automation
- Customer Intelligence
- Omnichannel Support

## Core Products & Platform

- [HubSpot CRM](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm): Free CRM platform with live chat, scheduling, and email tracking capabilities.
- [Smart CRM](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm/ai-crm): AI-powered customer intelligence and unified customer data platform.
- [Breeze AI](https://www.hubspot.com/products/artificial-intelligence): AI tools and agents including Customer Agent, Prospecting Agent, and Data Agent for business automation.
- [Sales Hub](https://www.hubspot.com/products/sales): AI-powered sales software with agents for prospecting and deal closing.
- [Marketing Hub](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing): AI-powered marketing software with lead generation and automation capabilities.
- [Service Hub](https://www.hubspot.com/products/service): Complete AI-powered customer service platform with omnichannel support and ticket management.
- [Content Hub](https://www.hubspot.com/products/content): Content management and multi-channel publishing software for content marketing.
- [Commerce Hub](https://www.hubspot.com/products/commerce): AI CPQ, billing, and payments software for quote management and payment processing.
- [Data Hub](https://www.hubspot.com/products/data): Data quality and business process automation for scaling businesses.

## Getting Started & Plans

- [Get Started](https://www.hubspot.com/products/get-started): Getting started guide for HubSpot customer platform and free tools.
- [Starter Plan](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm/starter): HubSpot Starter plan for small businesses and startups at $20/month.
